drop_patches.name: fix-py314-resource-annotations.patch
drop_patches.reason: Snapshot already imports annotations from __future__; subsequent import restructuring makes reverse patch context stale. Preserve existing postponed annotation semantics.

replace_files.name: control
replace_files.reason: New upstream keyring tests require the keyring extra during build; keep auth caching optional at runtime through Suggests. Match pinned pyproject minima keystoneauth1>=5.16.0 (BaseAuthPlugin.get_unscoped_cache_id, first released5.16.0) and os-service-types>=1.8.1 for builds and runtime.

replace_files.name: patches/series
replace_files.reason: Enable the isolated service catalog compatibility test patch while retaining the archive patch sequence.

add_files.name: patches/allow-newer-service-type-catalog.patch
add_files.reason: Downstream snapshot builds intentionally consume newer os-service-types catalogs. Retain a parsed ISO timestamp minimum check to reject stale or malformed catalog data while accepting the supported baseline and newer snapshots; do not disable the test or pin it to one transient nightly timestamp.
